Method of Attack: Fake Adobe Flash Player installers that install a cryptocurrency miner (XMRig) and also update the real Flash Player to appear legitimate; silently installs a coinminer that connects to a mining pool at xmr-eu1.nanopool.org and uses almost 100% CPU to mine Monero cryptocurrency
Discoverer: Brad Duncan, Palo Alto Unit 42 researcher
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Adobe Flash Player
Attack Vector: Fake Flash Player installer downloads from URLs containing 'flashplayer_down.php?clickid=' hosted on Amazon AWS instances
